senses.gloss: --from हिरण्यगर्भ: two parts, male and female; the male half divided into eleven parts called Rudras by crying and running (oozing); each became a गणेश्वर; the female half came to be divided into two, शुक्ल (right) and कृष्ण (left); from her came प्रज्ञा and श्री and these in turn spread over the whole world in thousand ways. वा. 9. ७५-98; ४१. ३६.

--शिव became this by worshipping शक्ति:
1: Br. II. २७. ९८; IV. 5. ३०; ४४. ४८.
Image of; with details of dress and ornaments.
2: M. ६०. २५; १९२. २८; २६०. 1-१०.
--one of the seven sons of वसिष्ठ. वा. २८. ३६.
--one of the four sons of the ३३र्द् Kalpa. वा. २३. ५९.
--one of the ten पीठस् for images. This yields one a number of sons. M. २६२. 7 and ११, १८.
